scope: source-only corrective census; no UI, test, build, model, Git, or canonical edits

controls.canonical_label: Organization picker appears for held request
controls.canonical_action: Trigger a request with no active organization; verify dialog opens from pending flag after panel-open and from broadcast while panel is already open.
controls.finding: Held-request picker and pending-flag/broadcast entry have no source; load ladder chooses at window load.
controls.safe_change: Retire T01-T03 procedure and expectation. Preserve cases/evidence; replacement checks load ladder and zero-membership refusal in new or revised cases.

controls.canonical_action: Open picker; verify loading state, backend read failure state, then retry after service recovery.
controls.finding: Membership loading and read error survive in Settings; picker and explicit retry button do not appear there. Hook exposes reload.
controls.safe_change: Replace T04-T05 picker steps with Settings Organization loading, failed read shown as error, and recovery after reload/reopen or filter change; do not assert a Retry button until implemented.

controls.canonical_action: Choose a listed membership; verify active device organization is updated and held request resumes.
controls.finding: Settings explicit switch persists device choice and account last active; no held request resumes.
controls.safe_change: Replace T06-T07 with Settings switch, device selection, account propagation, and subsequent request header. Remove dialog close/held-resume claims.

controls.canonical_label: Picker cannot be dismissed while choice is required
controls.canonical_action: With organizations available, press Escape and click outside; dialog remains until choice.
controls.finding: Required-choice dialog is absent; normal load selects a membership.
controls.safe_change: Retire T08-T10 Escape/outside-click checks; preserve historical evidence.

controls.canonical_action: With an empty membership list, verify honest empty state and create/join link.
controls.finding: Zero memberships remains a typed refusal with create/join URL in remedy; Settings has an empty state but no visible create/join link in inspected branch.
controls.safe_change: Replace T11-T12 with zero-membership refusal/remedy and Settings empty state. Treat clickable create/join remedy as a gap, not a pass.

controls.canonical_action: Close after no-members state; pending request flag clears.
controls.finding: No empty-state picker or pending flag exists.
controls.safe_change: Retire T13-T15 picker-close/pending-clear steps; preserve historical evidence.

controls.canonical_action: Force selection failure; verify error remains visible and retry is possible.
controls.finding: Settings choose failure sets visible orgError; picker remains absent.
controls.safe_change: Replace T16-T17 with failed Settings switch, visible error, retained prior selection, and successful retry by selecting again.

controls.canonical_action: Resolve selection through another surface; picker closes when active organization changes.
controls.finding: External storage selection is observed and hook reloads; there is no picker to close.
controls.safe_change: Replace T18-T20 with cross-context selection reflected in Settings and a request using the new organization; coordinate with T42-T43 instead of claiming picker closure.

controls.canonical_action: Select among memberships; no org fallback occurs while unset; surface error is shown on selection failure.
controls.finding: Settings selector and selection-error display survive; unset fallback premise is stale because load ladder selects an active membership.
controls.safe_change: Revise T21-T22: verify load ladder display, explicit switch, error, subsequent request. Remove no-fallback-while-unset assertion.

controls.canonical_action: Open/close the identity popover and inspect current account and desktop status.
controls.finding: Avatar identity popover and desktop state render from live hooks.
controls.safe_change: Keep T23-T25; source supports control, not a live pass.

controls.canonical_action: Choose Profile and verify it opens only when signed in.
controls.finding: Profile route is guarded by signed-in visibility.
controls.safe_change: Keep T26-T27; source supports control, not a live pass.

controls.canonical_action: Choose Preferences and verify Settings opens.
controls.finding: Preferences routes to Settings through sidepanel tab store.
controls.safe_change: Keep T28-T30; source supports control, not a live pass.

controls.canonical_action: Sign out and verify auth state changes without exposing stale signed-in-only tabs.
controls.finding: Sign-out action remains in user menu and auth hook clears user/admin state.
controls.safe_change: Keep T31-T32; stale-tab visibility requires product verification.

controls.canonical_action: When sign-in fails, activate Try again and inspect progress/error recovery.
controls.finding: AuthGate shows Try again and useAuth.retry can restart sign-in or recheck canonical session.
controls.safe_change: Keep T33-T35; source supports control, not a live pass.

controls.canonical_label: Start Safari sign-in in a background tab
controls.canonical_action: Start Safari OAuth from the extension using the configured Safari client and complete the callback into the extension session.
controls.finding: Safari authorization and callback survive, but chrome.tabs.create uses active: true; the canonical background-tab label is inaccurate if it means a nonfocused tab.
controls.safe_change: Keep T36 OAuth callback/session checks. Correct C15 label to Safari sign-in in an extension-owned tab; do not assert a nonfocused/background browser tab. Safari product pass remains unverified.

controls.canonical_label: Cancel or replace Safari sign-in attempt
controls.canonical_action: Cancel a pending sign-in or start a replacement; clear its state and close only the extension-owned authorization/callback tab.
controls.finding: Safari cancellation/replacement clears current attempt and closes only owned authorization/callback tab.
controls.safe_change: Keep T37 related clauses; Safari product pass remains unverified.

controls.canonical_label: Recover from Safari callback failure or timeout
controls.canonical_action: Surface cancellation, invalid callback, completion failure, or timeout and allow the person to retry.
controls.finding: Safari callback failure, completion failure, and timeout produce retryable failure paths.
controls.safe_change: Keep T37 related clauses; Safari product pass remains unverified.

controls.canonical_label: Retire organization-required notice after explicit selection
controls.canonical_action: An organization-required notice clears when a device organization is chosen, including a late-arriving stale notice.
controls.finding: Notice retirement on active organization still exists, including late arrival; selection path is Settings/load ladder, not picker.
controls.safe_change: Revise T38: exercise a real no-org refusal, then restoration/selection and late notice. Remove clear-device-and-trigger-picker premise; verify zero-member remedy separately.

controls.canonical_label: Archived organization eligibility and stale-choice recovery
controls.canonical_action: Archived organizations are not active request targets; a stale stored choice requires explicit active selection. Archived memberships remain discoverable through the archive filter.
controls.finding: Archived organizations are excluded from active choice; stale device selection is cleared and load ladder may choose next active membership automatically.
controls.safe_change: Revise T40: verify archived choice rejected/cleared, ladder outcome for zero/one/many memberships, archive discovery. Remove explicit-selection-always requirement.

controls.canonical_label: Organization archive filter in Settings and required-choice dialog
controls.canonical_action: Use shared Active only, All and Archived only controls; view archived memberships and restore remedy while preserving actual active organization.
controls.finding: Archive filter survives in Settings; required-choice dialog is absent.
controls.safe_change: Revise T41 to Settings filter only. Remove dialog and held-resume assertions. Check filter does not change actual active organization.

controls.canonical_label: Revalidate the admin gate across contexts and storage failures
controls.canonical_action: Serialize role-gate writes by auth generation, revalidate current identity and role, and surface storage/read failures without leaving an authorized stale gate.
controls.finding: Auth hook clears admin gate before revalidation and reports role/storage failures.
controls.safe_change: Keep T39; concurrency/storage rejection outcomes still need product or targeted verification.

controls.canonical_label: External active-organization update across extension contexts
controls.canonical_action: Update the device organization from a separate extension context; verify the live selection and a real organization-scoped request use the new organization, then restore the original choice.
controls.finding: Shared storage observer invalidates resolver cache and hook reloads across contexts.
controls.safe_change: Keep T42-T43 as historical native verification procedure; no new product pass claimed.

historical_evidence_policy: Keep all case IDs, cells, run IDs, defect IDs, and prior evidence. Source status is not a live pass. Modify stale steps/expected text only after carrying history forward.
case_status_policy: Only inspected behavior is classified; uninspected assertions within otherwise current cases remain UNKNOWN until exercised.
key_correction: C02 is replaced, not retired: Settings membership load/error survive. Its old picker and explicit Retry-button claims are stale. C15-C22 labels come verbatim from canonical inventory.json.
